Take a seat
You go take a seat. You can watch the Ellen Show or read a magazine.
Watch the Ellen show
You decide to watch the Ellen Show. You get to watch Cardi B perform. Then the therapist calls your name and asks you to go back with her.
Go back with the therapist
You go back with the therapist and she asks if you would like something to drink, you can have,
Red wine
You get your beverage. The therapist asks why you came in today. She would like you to use lots of details.
Explain the problem
You explain that you and your significant other are having the nothing fight and don't know how to solve it. She starts talking about zodiac compatibility. You can listen nicely or start to argue with her.
You listen nicely and all your problems were solved.
OK, no need to get snarky. What if I had argued?
You start to argue and say,
"This has nothing to do with Pisces hating Aries or Aquarius hating Capricorn, or everybody hating Gemini, this is about two people having a problem and needing it solved."
Then she asks both of you to take a lie detector test.
Take lie detector test
You go first on the test. The first question is,
"Have you had or are having an affair?", you answer with,
"No."
Ding-Ding
"Are you telling the truth?"
"Yes"
Ding-Ding
Your significant other has the same answers, but you think they are lying. You can let it go or attack them.
You decide to let it go and now you can peacefully resume the appointment.
As you resume the appointment, you see another couple brawling. You just know to let them be.
You get to the therapists office and now you can resume your conversation or tell her to die in a hole and leave.
You decide to resume the conversation. She asks you to choose a snack together to build cooperation skills, you sigh and say,
"Fine."
You choose pretzels and now she starts talking about what colors mean which feelings. You chould start listening or argue.
You start to argue and say,
"This is why I don't respect therapy. I don't believe in taking about which colors mean which feelings."
Then the therapist says, "Okay then, I guess we should change the topic."
She wants to know what you guys have in common. You can tell her or you can walk out and leave
You walk out and leave and you are never to be seen again.
Ugh, fine. I'll tell her what we have in common.
You decide to tell her what you have in common, you say,
"We are both angry at each other."
Now she wants you to tell her something you don't have in common.
column2:
You decide to tell her something you two don't have in common, and you say,
"I don't respect therapy but they do."
The therapist says,
"See, aren't we getting somewhere."
And you sigh and sarcastically say,
"Yes, yes we are."
Your appointment is over and now you need to say goodbye.
column3: You say goodbye to the therapist. Now you need to go to the gift shop to celebrate you and your significant other making up.

Angela stares at her, stunned, her unaffected smile completely gone. She looks wounded. You know that a horrible line has been crossed.
